newsitem.title: CHINA: SHANGHAI CLOTHING SALES VOLUME FALLS IN H1 1997.
newsitem.headline: SHANGHAI CLOTHING SALES VOLUME FALLS IN H1 1997.

text.p: Sales of clothing in Shanghai, long considered China's fashion capital, fell to 23.31 million garments in the first half of 1997, down 13.5 percent from the same 1996 period, the Liberation Daily said on Friday.
Blind investment in recent years was the reason for the sluggishness of the local clothing market, the newspaper said.
China's 23,000 garment producers had annual sales of more than one million yuan ($1.2 million), but most just copied each other's designs and this led to serious oversupply, it said.
Rapid development of other cities in east China had also attracted customers away from Shanghai, it added.
